name: Palm Burst
description: A short cone from your palms. Aim at a visible target; cover stops the blast. Original move adaptation.

name: Blast Dash
description: A bounded forward recoil impulse. Normal collision and fall damage apply. Original move adaptation.

name: AP Shot
description: A narrow blast ray that stops at the first visible target or solid block. Move-name localisation pending primary verification; mod timing/balance.

name: Recoil Dodge
description: A short backward impulse. Provides space, with no invulnerability or teleport. Original move adaptation.

name: Stun Grenade
description: A visible, low-damage pulse. Briefly slows ordinary enemies; bosses resist the control. No screen flash. Move-name localisation pending primary verification.

name: Burst Volley
description: Three aimed pulses at startup, then 4 and 8 ticks later. Cover can interrupt the sequence. Original move adaptation.

name: Aerial Redirection
description: Steer with recoil while airborne. No flight, phasing, or fall immunity. Original move adaptation.

name: Howitzer Impact
description: A long, interruptible windup followed by a bounded line-of-sight blast. Never destroys blocks. Move-name localisation pending primary verification; mod adaptation.

name: Ice Shot
description: Right-side precision ice. Lowers temperature by 15; solid cover stops the ray. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Flame Jet
description: Left-side short flame cone. Raises temperature by 15; does not ignite terrain. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Ice Wall
description: A three-by-three temporary ice wall. Empty, unoccupied positions only; finite lifetime and no block drops. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Ice Ramp
description: A temporary stepped rescue route. Collision and protection rules apply; never places inside entities. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Flame Sweep
description: A wider flame pressure sweep. Raises temperature by 25; cover and recovery provide counterplay. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Flashfreeze
description: A bounded cold pulse with a short slow. Bosses resist control; no immobilising terrain is placed on targets. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Thermal Shock
description: Mix both sides in a precision burst. Requires temperature within 25 of balance, then returns it to zero. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Flashfreeze Heatwave
description: A long, interruptible mixed release. Requires temperature within 40 of balance; no terrain destruction. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Harden
description: A two-second hardening window reduces damage by 35%. Impacts add fatigue; ordinary weapons remain usable. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Braced Step
description: Short grounded footwork. This is complementary movement, without teleportation or invulnerability. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Hardened Strike
description: A short hardened melee blow. A legitimately primed counter adds one bounded follow-up bonus. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Counter Guard
description: A short guard window. Blocking a real hostile impact primes one strike; no recursive reflected damage. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Stone Anchor
description: Rooted hardening adds knockback resistance while holding position. It reduces damage, without immunity. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Breakline
description: A close line-breaking blow with bounded knockback. Walls, team policy and armour still apply. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Bodyguard Advance
description: A short braced advance with a brief hardening window. Protection requires physically taking position. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Unbreakable
description: Five seconds of 50% reduction, with fatigue and punishable recovery. No invulnerability or flight. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Spark Touch
description: A close electrical strike. Spends charge and adds overload; ally and PvP protections remain active. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Grounding Step
description: Ordinary grounded footwork and a small load reduction. Not electric teleportation. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Directional Arc
description: A narrow aimed discharge that stops at solid cover and the first eligible target. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Static Net
description: A short nearby disruption pulse. Brief slows, boss resistance and protection checks prevent stun-lock. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Charge Capacitor
description: An exposed recharge stance. Adds 30 charge and 10 load; it grants no mastery for repeated use. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Chain Discharge
description: Up to three eligible targets. Each hop needs six-block range and clear sight; never recursively chains/reflections. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Grounding Stance
description: A grounded recovery stance that removes 25 overload. It provides no damage immunity. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Maximum Discharge
description: A heavy radial discharge adds 70 load. Exceeding tolerance causes a visible six-second recovery; ordinary survival remains usable. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Cobalt Stream
description: A finite blue-flame stream, at most three damage attempts eight ticks apart. Listed damage is per successful pulse; hurt resistance and cover apply. Adds 18 heat. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Ash Step
description: Complementary grounded footwork. No flame flight, teleport or immunity. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Blue Lance
description: A narrow aimed blue-flame release. Stops at the first eligible target or solid cover; adds 24 heat. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Cinder Fan
description: A short fan of blue flame. No terrain fires; adds 22 heat. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Controlled Cooling
description: A two-second exposed cooling stance removes 35 heat gradually. Interruption ends cooling; no immunity or repeated-cast mastery. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Azure Ring
description: A bounded radial blue-flame release. Solid cover still protects targets; adds 32 heat. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Scorched Retreat
description: A grounded backward withdrawal, without teleportation. Adds 10 heat and grants no invulnerability. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Bluefire Front
description: A highly telegraphed blue-flame front, at most four attempts eight ticks apart. Listed damage is per successful pulse; adds 55 heat. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Shadow Lash
description: A precise shade strike. A legitimate hit leaves your six-second shadow mark; failed damage and dummies never create one. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Shade Slip
description: Grounded evasive footwork under a fleeting shade. No teleportation or invulnerability. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Umbral Bind
description: Requires and consumes your own visible shadow mark. Brief resisted slowing; no permanent root or terrain cage. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Dusk Mantle
description: Two seconds of 35% projectile reduction. Melee and environmental hazards bypass the veil. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Silhouette Decoy
description: One short-lived immobile shadow mannequin. May distract at most eight visible nearby hostile mobs; no player control, drops, XP or mastery. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Shadow Reel
description: Consumes your own visible mark for a bounded pull. Bosses resist displacement; cover breaks the connection. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Midnight Stride
description: A longer grounded stride. Ordinary collision, recovery and fall damage remain; no travel through walls. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Eclipse Well
description: A telegraphed local shade release with three finite attempts. Cover and repeated-control resistance apply; never darkens another player's screen. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Absorb Brace
description: A 20% physical-impact guard. Legitimate hostile blocked damage stores energy, capped at ten per hit and sixty total; each hit adds fatigue. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Inertial Jab
description: Complementary physical jab, usable with no stored energy. Ordinary weapons also remain available. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Recoil Step
description: Complementary grounded footwork; requires no stored impact and provides no immunity. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Counter Release
description: Spends 20 stored impact in a narrow release. Cover stops it; interrupting the cast does not refund energy. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Damping Guard
description: Spends ten impact for a finite 25% physical-impact guard. Real blocked impacts can recharge storage; fatigue prevents indefinite guarding. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Stored Vault
description: Spends 15 stored impact in a bounded grounded vault. Collision and fall damage remain; no flight or teleportation. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Impact Wave
description: Spends 35 impact in a short radial wave with bounded knockback. Allies, protected contacts and targets behind cover are excluded. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Kinetic Bulwark
description: Spends 25 impact for a three-second 40% physical-impact guard. Real blocked impacts add fatigue; environmental hazards bypass it. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.

name: Singular Release
description: Spends all sixty stored impact in a heavily telegraphed release. No automatic charging, recursive reflection or terrain destruction. Mod-original timing/balance and working move label.
